claims.assertion: Swaruu X defines karma as cause and effect, with consequences interpreted by the person; she rejects external religious punishment and says people bear responsibility for their actions.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X

claims.assertion: She describes “Lion’s Gate” as coded symbolism for summer’s Leo onset, not an August 8 or galactic-new-year portal; she says a real portal opens near the summer solstice.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X
claims.qualifiers: These are her interpretations of the named event and portal.
